[RFCS.7.5] A `FactRetract` carries the `seq` and `clock_ns` of the stream
event that reported the retraction, as every other event atom carries its
own: `seq` is the event's place in the delivered stream ([LFST.12.1]), and
`clock_ns` is the engine's monotonic clock when the engine applied the
retraction, as `FactAssert`'s is at the assertion ([RFCS.6.2]). An encoder
must write both. A retraction then has a position of its own in a trace, not
only the place it happens to sit in the file.
